snippet.title: Penelope Pendrick and the Art of Deceit Cinematic Trailer
snippet.description:
Penelope Pendrick and the Art of Deceit is a point and click mystery adventure game full of interrogations, puzzles, and danger! Try the demo on Steam now or play the full game November 19th!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3148060/Penelope_Pendrick_and_the_Art_of_Deceit/
